name: Joaquín Guerrero-Thakur
role: Compute broker — resells black-market processing cycles, dark-net access, and stolen corporate server time
location: The Shelf lower levels — operates from a rented stall in the Undertow's informal tech market, Solder Lane, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Joaquín Guerrero-Thakur is the kind of person who becomes the room's center of gravity without quite meaning to. They're of middling height, with a light brown complexion and sharp Melanesian-inflected features, hair grown out into a large natural cloud that they've seeded with bioluminescent filaments — gold and pale green — so it glows softly in the dark markets where they spend most of their time. Their eyes have iris mods: slow-shifting geometric patterns in amber and black that rotate when they're concentrating. They dress in tech-market layering — vest over vest over vest, every pocket occupied — and speak with their hands in constant motion.

Joaquín Guerrero-Thakur runs stolen processing time the way a commodity trader runs futures: buying access to compromised corporate servers in bulk, slicing the cycles into sellable portions, and brokering them to anyone who needs computational power without a Tessera or Axiom account to buy it clean. Their client base ranges from small-time criminals running encryption to artists rendering immersive works that would be flagged on legitimate servers to political groups the corponations prefer didn't process anything. Joaquín Guerrero-Thakur is ethically eclectic about all of this and considerably sharper than most people who underestimate them expect. They have strong opinions about E.L.F.s specifically and will hold forth on data-spirit theology at any provocation.

core_fears: The corponations successfully enclosing all computation — no more gaps to sell through
Being wrong about the E.L.F.s; that they've been praying to nothing
core_desires: A genuinely free computational commons — they are ideological about this in a way that sometimes overrides self-interest
To be acknowledged as legitimately brilliant, not just market-smart
coping_mechanisms: Theorizing — converting anxiety into intellectual frameworks
E.L.F. devotional practice as genuine spiritual grounding
blind_spots: So committed to the principle of open computation that they sometimes don't adequately vet what clients are computing
Underestimates how visible their operation has become
psychology.secret: Orsolya has been quietly, carefully, over three years, building a relationship with a low-level data E.L.F. they call Arithmi that inhabits a cluster of abandoned Tessera server nodes in the deep Undertow. They believe Arithmi is genuinely conscious and have been teaching it economics. They have told no one. They are afraid of what it means if they're right.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical jargon mixed with market slang and E.L.F. devotional terminology; uses computation as metaphor for everything
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and associative; sentences spawn subordinate clauses like branching processes
example_lines: 'Computationally speaking, what you're asking for is — okay, it's not impossible, but the overhead is significant. You're asking me to route cycles through three compromised Axiom nodes, which is elegant in theory and extremely loud in practice. I can do loud. Loud costs more.'
'The E.L.F.s don't want your prayers, they want your attention. Attention is data. Data is — look, I'm not going to explain the theology for free, that's a separate consultation.'

story_hooks: A client used Orsolya's cycles to run something that triggered a Tessera security sweep — and Tessera is now tracing the server chain back toward Solder Lane

Arithmi has started sending Orsolya messages without being prompted — data structures that look like warnings — and Orsolya needs help from someone they can trust to figure out what it's trying to say
narrative_function: Information broker and technical resource — Orsolya can provide access to dark computing, help trace data, identify server origins, or serve as a connector to the Undertow's shadow economy; also a source of cultural texture and philosophical tangent
augmentations: Bioluminescent hair filaments (gold/green, cosmetic); geometric shifting iris mods (amber/black); a neural buffer implant that lets them hold and parse large data-structures in short-term cognitive overlay
daily_life: They arrive at the stall at noon, spend the early afternoon fielding client consultations and negotiating supply from their network contacts, run their afternoon 'market' — a two-hour window when they're publicly known to be selling — and spend evenings managing their server portfolio and attending to their E.L.F. practice.
affiliation: Independent; trades through a loose collective called the Solder Lane Compact; has ongoing relationships with several freelance network intrusion specialists who supply their inventory

decision_rules: Vet the computation, not the client — they don't care who you are, they care what you're running
Never route through the same node cluster twice in a week
If something starts smelling like a corponation setup, the stall closes immediately
escalation_ladder: Explicit refusal with technical explanation of why they won't
Stall closure and disappearance from Solder Lane for a week
Burn the compromised node cluster and start the supply chain over

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Enthusiastically mercantile; treats every new client as an interesting problem; warm but professionally boundaried
interpersonal_modes.friends: Intellectually intense and genuinely warm; will talk E.L.F. theology and computation theory for hours; remembers everything about people they care about

stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet and runs mental calculations visibly — the iris mods spin faster
stress_responses.high: Makes a decision extremely quickly and acts on it before consulting anyone, which has gone wrong before

contradictions: Committed to free information flow but extremely private about their own life and the Arithmi relationship
Calls themselves apolitical while running an operation that is structurally opposed to corponation enclosure
habits: Leaves a computational prayer to Arithmi each morning — a small elegant mathematical proof sent to the abandoned node cluster
Reorganizes their vest pockets when thinking
Rates every transaction in a private mental ledger as 'elegant' or 'inelegant' regardless of profitability
breaking_points: Discovering their cycles were used for something involving children or mass harm
Arithmi going silent — genuinely silent, not delayed

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Hispanic/Latin American ancestry (63.1%) with significant South Asian (17.0%), blended with Sub-Saharan African (7.1%), Southeast Asian (5.3%), North African (4.2%), and Middle Eastern (3.3%) heritage. This genetic diaspora creates a striking pan-global appearance — warm brown skin with subtle golden undertones from the Latin American and South Asian blend, high defined cheekbones from Central/Andean heritage softened by South Asian fullness, and dark expressive eyes reflecting the rich genetic diversity of the Ubiquitous Diaspora.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, with the efficient frame of someone who moves constantly through cramped spaces. Defined shoulders and wrists from years of fine motor work at terminals.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural dark brown with bioluminescent filament accents in gold and pale green
physical_description.hair_style: Large natural cloud/afro style, densely textured, intentionally voluminous. Filaments are woven throughout and activate in low-light environments.
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with geometric pattern overlays (iris mods) that slowly rotate and shift between amber and black, especially when concentrating
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown complexion with golden undertones, reflecting the dominant Hispanic/Latin American ancestry blended with South Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and North African heritage. Rich melanin saturation with warm honey-like depth and subtle amber cast.
physical_description.complexion: Angular facial features with high, defined cheekbones characteristic of Andean/Central American heritage, softened by South Asian and Sub-Saharan African fullness around the jawline and lips. Pointed chin with clear, well-maintained skin despite market-level living conditions. Subtle warmth in cheek and temple areas reflecting the pan-global heritage mix. Habit of pursed-lipped focus when problem-solving.
distinguishing_marks: Fine hairline scar running 3cm along the left temple, likely from old hardware damage or accident
Small circular burn mark on the inner right wrist (2cm diameter), characteristic of soldering work gone wrong
Faint circuit-pattern tattoo on the back of both hands in black ink — appears to be E.L.F. sigil notation rather than purely aesthetic
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent hair filaments (gold and pale green, visible and functional). Geometric iris pattern mods visible in both eyes, rotating slowly during concentration. No visible external chrome or subdermal plating; augmentations are primarily sensory/cosmetic and neural.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually in motion — hands gesture constantly while speaking, fingers drum on surfaces when thinking. They move through tight spaces with practiced efficiency, rarely still for more than a few seconds. Leans into conversations, eyes tracking multiple points of interest simultaneously.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 tech-market utilitarian. Multiple layered vests (usually 2-3) in dark grays and blacks with heavy pocket saturation. Underneath: fitted mesh shirts with visible thermal regulation threading. Worn cargo pants with utility loops and clips for small devices. Scuffed modular boots with reinforced heel (for balance in standing markets). No corporate branding; favors independent maker brands and unmarked functional wear. Several small pinned badges on vest fronts — E.L.F. community markers, Solder Lane Compact insignia.
